## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing and SPY/TLT (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +4.12%) ABOVE TREND showing stocks outperforming bonds, while HYG/LQD ratio ↓ (credit stress signal) and Credit Spread (0.7472; 1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION create the conflicting signal set.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD ↓ with HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY. Gold inflows supportive: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-benign: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY indicating mixed duration appetite; Dollar weakness: Dollar Strength (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/industrial strength: XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND and Materials vs Staples ↑ rising. Energy lagging and divergent: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION; Utilities weak: XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leading (XLK/XLF both positive and breadth confirms).

5. US vs Global?
US leadership: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) RECOVERY while China FXI (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) CORRECTION shows 1W weakness vs stronger 1M performance.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation recovering: ARKK (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND. Small caps healthy: IWM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND supporting risk-on microstructure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial commodities mixed but supportive: CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing divergence: BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION while XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION — watch for mean reversion risk; Nat gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Equity breadth broad (8/11) with XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple commodity/energy ETFs (BNO, USO, XLE) in CORRECTION indicate sector-specific pullbacks; overall divergences are MINOR (not a ≥3-core ETF MAJOR divergence).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure (XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, IGV (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +9.38%) ABOVE TREND) and materials cyclicals (XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to energy beta and utilities (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION, XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology — XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND; Materials — XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION; Utilities — XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Gold — GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND; Silver — SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil complex — BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -8.66% | 1M: +8.23%) CORRECTION; Nat gas — UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND) as complacency threshold; Credit Spread 0.7472 (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION for credit stress watch; XLK/XLF 3.2634 (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -2.14%) RECOVERY as growth vs financials pivot; SPY/TLT 9.3434 (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +4.12%) ABOVE TREND for risk-on validation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, conflicting signals between easing fear and credit stress. Tech and materials showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND; XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND) while HYG/LQD ↓ and energy CORRECTIONS (XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION) are key divergences to monitor.
